comment: Font families permitted in a packaged build. A family that appears in neither 'families' nor 'unresolved' fails verify-bundled-fonts.mjs. Commercial faces (the HanYi hy-* set, Microsoft DengXian) reached the bundle once through the presentation runtime; this gate exists so that cannot happen quietly again.

unresolved.lucide: Shipped by presentation-assets as a woff2 subset with no licence file in that package. Lucide upstream is ISC, but the subset's provenance is not recorded here; record it and move this entry into families.
unresolved.remix: Shipped by presentation-assets as a woff2 subset with no licence file in that package. Remix Icon upstream is Apache-2.0, but the subset's provenance is not recorded here; record it and move this entry into families.

denied.hy-: HanYi commercial typefaces; redistribution requires a licence this project does not hold
denied.dengxian: Microsoft DengXian; ships with Windows and Office and is not redistributable
